description.en: Mistings are by far the most common type of Metalborn across both eras.

**Prerequisite** Human or koloss-blooded ancestry; no other Snap or Heritage talent.

Gain an Investiture score, the Drink Vial action, the Allomancy skill, and one nascent Allomantic power.
Your max Investiture increases by your tier.
Your power's range increases by one rank in Allomancy, and maintaining its effect costs 1 fewer Investiture.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Use the nascent version of your Allomantic powers even while at 0 Investiture or otherwise Depleted.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 5+.

After you complete the **Become a Savant** goal, your power is amplified by 2 Investiture. While Depleted, you suffer withdrawal.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

After a long rest, choose one of your Allomantic powers. You can use its Burn action before each scene.
Mistborn are the most iconic and legendary Metalborn of Scadrial.

**Prerequisite** Human ancestry; no other Snap or Heritage talent.

Gain an Investiture score, the Drink Vial action, the Allomancy skill, and all nascent Allomantic powers.
Your max Investiture increases by your tier.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Use the nascent version of your Allomantic powers even while at 0 Investiture or otherwise Depleted.
When you make a test for an Allomantic power, spend to also use another nascent power.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

Use an Allomantic power by becoming Depleted of that power instead of spending Investiture.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

After a long rest, choose one of your Allomantic powers. You can use its Burn action before each scene.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+.

**Spend 2 focus** to gain 2 actions for activating your Allomantic powers.
Full Feruchemists can use the metalminds of every Feruchemical metal, storing many of their traits in preparation for tapping them later.

**Prerequisite** Human ancestry; no other Snap or Heritage talent.

Gain the Feruchemy skill and all nascent Feruchemical powers. You can wear metalminds up to your Intellect score.
Your maximum metalmind charge increases by a number equal to your tier.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

You can simultaneously wear metalminds up to your Feruchemy modifier (instead of your Intellect score).

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 4+.

Embed a metalmind in your skin. It can't be affected by most Invested abilities, and it'll usually be overlooked.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Use your Feruchemical Store actions as free action.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

After a long rest, choose one of your Feruchemical powers. You can use its Tap action before each scene.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 4+.

Spend 2 focus to gain for tapping your Feruchemical powers.
After the Catacendre, a new type of Metalborn began to appear: Ferrings, who can use only one Feruchemical power.

**Prerequisite** Human or koloss-blooded ancestry; no other Snap or Heritage talent.

Gain the Feruchemy skill and one nascent Feruchemical power.
Your maximum metalmind charge increases by a number equal to your tier.

**Prerequisite** Willpower 4+.

While your metalmind has no charges, **spend 3 focus** instead of a charge.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 4+.

Embed a metalmind in your skin. It can't be affected by most Invested abilities, and it'll usually be overlooked.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Use your Feruchemical Store actions as free action.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

After a long rest, choose one of your Feruchemical powers. You can use its Tap action before each scene.
The Twinborn of Era 2 have both Allomantic and Feruchemical heritage, allowing them to wield both an Allomantic power and a Feruchemical power.

**Prerequisite** Human or koloss-blooded ancestry; no other Snap or Heritage talent.

Gain an Investiture score, the Drink Vial action, the Allomancy and Feruchemy skills, one nascent Allomantic power, and one nascent Feruchemical power.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 2+.

Use your Feruchemical Store actions as free action.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 3+.

After a long rest, choose one of your Feruchemical powers. You can use its Tap action before each scene.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+.

After a long rest, choose one of your Allomantic powers. You can use its Burn action before each scene.
Your max Investiture increases by your tier.
Your maximum metalmind charge increases by a number equal to your tier.

**Prerequisite** Feruchemy 4+.

Embed a metalmind in your skin. It can't be affected by most Invested abilities, and it'll usually be overlooked.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+; Feruchemy 3+; your two powers use the same metal.

Drink Vial to consume part of your metalmind, enabling you to spend Investiture (instead of charges) to fuel your Feruchemical power.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 4+; Feruchemy 4+.

While using **Compounder**, **spend Investiture** to recharge your metalmind.

**Prerequisite** Your two powers use different metals.

**Spend 1 metalmind charge** to gain an advantage with your Allomantic power, or **spend 1 Investiture** to gain an advantage with your Feruchemical power.

**Prerequisite** Allomancy 3+; Feruchemy 3+.

After using **Alloyed Resonance**, also gain the full benefits of the other power.
